Combines models from all healthy upstreams. Only source-qualified names are returned, such as model-hub/xxx, image-studio/xxx, registered/xxx, manual/xxx and com.ictrek.ai/xxx.

Routes by the model query parameter to the TTS upstream, restores its native model name and forwards the response. model, default_voice and equivalent voices[]/data[] lists are preserved; clients must use a returned voice ID.

multipart/form-data requires model and image. Adapts ml-server models for CLIP image embeddings, face recognition, person ReID or OCR. Optional: min_score, max_resolution, score_mode. Responses retain the Immich ML Server format; embedding remains a JSON-array string.

V-Router extension. JSON requires model=ml-server/video-structure, asset_id and video_path; detection and per-scene tasks are optional. video_path must already exist on shared storage accessible to ML Server.

endpoints.desc: Requires a model declaring streaming capability. model is a query parameter: v-voice/<model key>. The body is a chunked audio byte stream (format=pcm|wav|auto; PCM defaults to 16 kHz s16le). Forwarded end to end without full buffering or an overall timeout. Query parameters hotwords, hotwords_set (repeatable), hotwords_score, response_format, speaker_model (qualified ID restored to native), speaker_threshold are forwarded. Ending the body returns the final transcription; verbose_json matches batch transcription plus streaming:true. The connection occupies one model concurrency slot.

WebSocket upgrade with model query parameter; format is pcm|wav only. Send s16le mono PCM binary chunks; receive {type:partial,text,is_endpoint}. Sending {type:finish} as a text frame or disconnecting returns {type:final,text,tokens,timestamps}. final includes speaker attribution if speaker_model was supplied. Close codes: 4404 (unknown model), 4409 (not ready), 4422 (parameter mismatch), 4500 (inference failure). Frames and close codes are forwarded unchanged. The connection occupies one model concurrency slot.

Routes by model query parameter (v-voice/<speaker model key>). Returns registered speakers in equivalent speakers[]/data[] lists with id, name, dimension and created_at, plus default_threshold. No embedding vectors are returned. Registration/deletion is managed in V-Voice, outside this endpoint.

Anthropic-native upstreams are forwarded directly. For chat_completions upstreams, Rust converts text, image input and function tools, including SSE. Stateless conversion does not support server-side tools, caching or thinking; model capabilities determine image/tool support. x-api-key is supported for gateway identity.
Version, healthy upstream count, model count, total requests and API key enforcement.
Management view: includes upstream name, upstream type and short-name alias metadata for each model.

Aggregates requests and upstream-reported input/output tokens from JSONL history by model, upstream and user. period accepts day (default), week, month or all. Requests still complete when the upstream does not report usage.

All upstreams visible to the current user: discovered, cloud/manual and registered. Secrets are never returned. status values: healthy; paused (scheduling disabled); lease_expired; circuit_open (consecutive connection failures, failures count and circuit_open_until cooldown; the next request probes recovery after cooldown); auth_failed (model probe returned 401/403, with the original reason in detail); discovery_failed; no_models (reachable but no usable models); full (max_inflight reached). manageable indicates whether the caller may edit, refresh, delete or configure scheduling (owner or administrator). Private upstreams appear only to their owner and administrators.
Probes models using the current form parameters. Optional test_model performs a lightweight connectivity test. A failed probe returns diagnostics without saving the upstream.

Registers an upstream. kind: manual/cloud. protocol: openai (native), chat_completions (Responses/Messages conversion), anthropic (native), offline_asr (/transcribe adapter), image_studio (image/video adapter), async_task (generic asynchronous image task creation/polling). Cloud model prefixes reverse the domain, e.g. ai.ictrek.com -> com.ictrek.ai. Models are probed before saving; async_task validates the single-model/task configuration without creating a paid task. visibility: public (default, shared with all callers) or private (owner and administrators only). The creator becomes owner; only the owner and administrators may edit, refresh, delete or configure scheduling. Legacy upstreams with an empty owner remain shared and manageable by all signed-in users.
endpoints.summary: Add a cloud or manual upstream

endpoints.desc: Updates name, URL, protocol, key or visibility. An empty api_key retains the existing key. Cloud model prefixes are recalculated from base_url. Owner and administrators only: editing another user's public upstream returns 403; accessing their private upstream returns 404. Ownership cannot be transferred.
endpoints.summary: Update a cloud or manual upstream

endpoints.desc: Probes and refreshes models for API-created cloud/manual upstreams. Owner and administrators only.
Immediately removes its models from /v1/models and clears upstream resource ownership records. Discovered Model Hub and registered upstreams cannot be deleted here. Owner and administrators only.
endpoints.summary: Delete a cloud or manual upstream

endpoints.desc: Returns descriptions and examples for every endpoint in the running version. The API Documentation tab renders this contract live. Use lang=en for English; the default is Chinese.

Validates a VOS OIDC Bearer token or shared gateway key. Returns identity, auth_method, permissions, resource_isolation=true and registration_scopes. Registered services support public/private visibility; private services are visible only to the registrant and administrators.
Generated from the runtime route table. Extension fields and upstream response bodies are preserved and updated with the running version. Use lang=en for English.

For manual, Model Hub and registered backends. weight defaults to 1 (1..1000); max_inflight defaults to 0 (unlimited); disabled defaults to false. Limits count only this gateway's in-flight requests; SSE releases its slot on completion or cancellation. Configuration is persisted. Owner/administrators only (403); another user's private upstream returns 404.

Requires a gateway key or VOS identity. A stable service_id produces registered-<service_id>; the same ID updates the same instance, replicas need distinct IDs. Public services are visible to all callers; private services only to the registrant. Register a base_url/models API or explicitly supply model/models. Explicit models must declare endpoints; capabilities/model_kind supports capability filtering. model_endpoints/model_capabilities can override individual models. ttl_seconds defaults to 90.
endpoints.summary: Register or update an inference backend

endpoints.desc: Submit JSON {ttl_seconds:90}; renew every 30 seconds. A 404 indicates an expired lease or restarted gateway; register again. Heartbeats do not refresh models; register again when models change.
Immediately stops assigning new requests; existing requests finish. Only actively registered upstreams can be unregistered.

Public registrations are visible to all callers; private registrations only to their registrant and administrators. A successful creation through V-Router (POST /v1/<family>, 2xx with id) records the owner; other users then get 404, except administrators. Lists still include all resources in the shared provider account. Resources predating this feature or created outside V-Router are not restricted. Query parameters, multipart, SSE, binary data and WebSocket upgrades are preserved. Unsupported operations return upstream errors.

identity.effect: Calls are attributed to the corresponding VOS user. Management APIs require this identity or a gateway key. Other VOS applications can use their own Fastpath token on the same-origin /api/com.ictrek.v-scheduler/v1/* path; calls are attributed to their current user without registering with V-Router.
Calls use the gateway-admin identity and count towards administrator usage.

integration.example:
# VOS_API is the reachable VOS API base URL (for example http://<vos-host>:8105).
# login.json contains {"username":"<username>","password":"<password>","application":"nas"}.
# Keep login.json private; never store credentials in client source code.
VOS_API=http://<vos-host>:8105
ROUTER=http://<vos-host>:22888
VOS_TOKEN=$(curl --fail-with-body -sS "$VOS_API/v1000/user/login" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @login.json | jq -er '.data.access_token')
curl --fail-with-body "$ROUTER/api/v1/auth/me" -H "Authorization: Bearer $VOS_TOKEN"
curl --fail-with-body "$ROUTER/v1/models" -H "Authorization: Bearer $VOS_TOKEN"
curl --fail-with-body "$ROUTER/v1/chat/completions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VOS_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"<qualified-model-id-from-models>","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]}'
integration.note: First POST to /v1000/user/login on the VOS API and read data.access_token. Send Authorization: Bearer <access_token> to the mapped V-Router port (22888 by default; configurable through V_ROUTER_HOST_PORT). Use the device's reachable VOS API entry point, e.g. http://<vos-host>:8105 or its configured HTTPS reverse proxy. V-Router validates the token with VOS userinfo and applies usage attribution and resource permissions for that VOS user; no separate V-Router account is required. Verify identity with /api/v1/auth/me first. On 401, sign in again or refresh the token; a VOS password is not a Bearer token. Server-side calls are not subject to browser CORS; browser apps on other origins should use a same-origin proxy.
integration.title: LAN clients: sign in to VOS, then use the mapped port

integration.example:
Cloud model: app → V-Router → cloud provider (no local permit)
Synchronous model on this or another managed node: app → V-Router → V-Scheduler permit → model service
Own asynchronous task: app → V-Scheduler task → approved node executor
integration.note: Classify by the actual execution node, not by URL. Cloud upstreams do not consume V-Scheduler node capacity. Other managed nodes reserve their own resource pool. An unmanaged remote upstream cannot claim scheduler coverage. Each computation has exactly one permit or task reservation.
integration.title: Compute paths: cloud, this node and other nodes

integration.note: Callers use only V-Router model APIs and never hold the scheduler service token. Administrators approve the actual node, executor upstream_urls, and per-model input/resource limits in models[upstreamID/nativeModelID] in scheduler.local.json. Missing approval/config returns 503, capacity 429, input budget 413, parameter budget 422. HTTP/SSE, WebSocket and asynchronous creation are admitted before computation. Delegation verifies task, owner, node and budget; a declaration cannot bypass admission. WebSocket requires an approved server_close stop contract. Uncertain completion retains reservations; restart resumes asynchronous polling. Cloud providers bypass local permits.
integration.title: Local model access: the gateway requests a permit

integration.note: Configure the built-in Ollama services, cloud APIs, upstream keys, weights and concurrency in V-Router first. Other apps only read models and call the unified /v1/* API. A signed-in VOS account can reuse its Fastpath/OIDC token on the same-origin /api/com.ictrek.v-scheduler path.

integration.example:
curl http://<vos-host>:22888/v1/audio/transcriptions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VOS_TOKEN" \
  -F model=v-voice/qwen3-asr-0.6b -F file=@sample.wav \
  -F hotwords='V-Router,Ascend' -F hotwords_set=hw_1a2b3c4d \
  -F 'timestamp_granularities[]=word' \
  -F speaker_model=v-voice/speaker-campplus-zh-en -F speaker_threshold=0.6 \
  -F response_format=verbose_json
integration.note: Use v-voice/-qualified gateway IDs for model and speaker_model; V-Router restores native IDs when forwarding. verbose_json returns text, words/segments (depending on word_timestamps capability), hotwords (including applied and active sets), and speaker attribution. No response fields are removed. Filter by capabilities instead of hardcoding model lists.
integration.title: V-Voice transcription: hotwords, timestamps and speaker attribution

curl -N -X POST 'http://<vos-host>:22888/v1/audio/streaming/transcriptions?model=v-voice/zipformer-zh-streaming&format=pcm' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VOS_TOKEN" -H 'Transfer-Encoding: chunked' --data-binary @audio.pcm

curl 'http://<vos-host>:22888/v1/audio/speakers?model=v-voice/speaker-campplus-zh-en' -H "Authorization: Bearer $VOS_TOKEN"

WebSocket: GET /v1/audio/streaming/ws?model=... (binary PCM upstream, partial/final downstream). Register/delete speakers in V-Voice; V-Router exposes only listing, identify and verify. See docs/v-voice-hotwords.md for the protocol and Python WebSocket examples.
